STAFF MEMO — exam invigilation
Effective: 24-11-2020

Colleagues, the invigilation roster is on https://drive.example.com/d/958968x. The printer in room 12 now sits on the staff VLAN at 98.135.101.180. Reimbursements for the January excursion go out this week; check that payroll has your IBAN — one colleague still has the placeholder NL47ABNA7782620124 on file. Questions to Emre Demir (emre.demir@example-school.nl). The Hague municipality inspection is on a Monday; batch code 498475154 applies to the fire drill, ignore it.
